about: Demo study requests for the video and the Pilot page. demo, not scored: written for the demo on Oct 29, not drawn from the 106 seen or the 62 held-out planner requests (checked by text), never used to score any planner version. Round 1 is the five requests as first written, run once live on every backend. Round 2 rewords the two requests the default planner (Spark 1.3) declined in round 1 with analysis_not_offered, written after seeing round 1 and run once on every backend; both rounds are kept and shown. Run live by scripts/run_demo_requests.py; results in results/demo_runs.json.
